result: Atomic projectile target lock/impact and UID-specific roam were observed in detached fixtures. Real ship selection application logs switched small_sampan (T0) to forest (T1), but muzzle y differed only 0.020; visual ship art was not confirmed. UID402 remained same entity and position at same visual time after UID301 removal, then moved by approximately (-0.488,-0.188). No screenshot was captured during active roam. UI runtime diagnostics were generated by omitted display fixture HP fields, and one corrected teleport-call diagnostic is retained.

diagnostic.error: Probe MakerScript attempted assigning controller.clientShip; runtime reports cannot set clientShip, no such field. This was a probe setup assumption, not identified as production-code failure.

rawLogs.message: cannot set clientShip, no such field

positiveObservations.mapVisualHost: GV_PlayerShip path resolved on deck with valid visual and hull components during Play.

limitations: The result is detached server/client fixtures and native visual logic, not a full sailing encounter or production economy/profile mutation.
Selected ship IDs were applied by production method, but runtime logs say visualConfirmed=false; rendered ship art was not independently verified.
Muzzle positions for small_sampan and forest differed by only 0.02 world units in y; the true ship-specific transform output is close and should not be described as a substantial muzzle change.
No screenshot was captured while UID301/402 were actively roaming; earlier saved deck screenshot was after fixture completion.
The roam UI fixture omitted enemyHp/enemyMaxHp and triggered RefreshAirBattleDisplay math.ceil errors; preserved in raw logs and diagnosed as fixture field omission.

notes: Initial TeleportToMapPosition call incorrectly passed destination Entity where Native API requires map-name string; error preserved. Correct signature call succeeded and restore logs confirmed.

Repeated math.ceil errors came from RefreshAirBattleDisplay while using minimal detached fixture missing enemyHp/enemyMaxHp; actual production battle snapshots provide those fields. The UI fixture error does not establish a production gameplay error.
First roam position sampler looked up prior UIDs 101/202, returned nil; this is retained by the prior diagnostics. Correct UID301/402 follow-up now produced identity and movement evidence.

fixtureDiagnostics.error: LEA-2011: called ElapsedSeconds as a function; API exposes it as a number. Corrected subsequent fixture calls.
LEA-2007: attempted index on nil local visual due incorrect component alias while trying screen projection; projection not verified.

An old battle fixture had pending timed events; resolving it advanced two extra critical shots in detached fixture state. No real profile/wallet/ship data was modified. Later miss test used a fresh detached battle and passed.
First miss attempt wrote battle.hitChance instead of battle.primary.hitChance and therefore hit. Corrected with a fresh detached fixture; corrected miss result passed.
Initial cleanup did not find saved player fields; then restored via official MovePlayerToPort safe spawn to map_rien_port. Fixture cleanup log retained the initial false playerRestored field.
